description.value:
Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Sephirotic Scion heritage: Ophanic.

“The wheels were full of eyes. You never stop turning. You never stop seeing.”

Sephirotic Scion (Ophanic). Your blood runs rotating. The Ophanim are wheels-and-eyes — motion, sight, the order that is always already looking both ways. You are descended from a thing that could not be snuck up on because it had no back. You kept some of that. Not all. Enough.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic Scion).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Sephirotic Scion does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Intrigue in fiction and through Tier powers.

Sephirotic Scion Core: The Higher Register

Shared across all Sephirotic Scion heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Sephirotic Physiology. You have resistance to sephirotic damage. Your blood runs a little bright under the right light; you do not technically age while on consecrated ground.

  • Sefirot Attunement. At creation, pick one sephirah (player choice). Once per scene, you can invoke its register and gain a +1 rank bonus to one check that falls clearly within that sephirah's domain.

  • Holy Conduit. Manifestations, rituals, and other sephirotic-register effects that target you or pass through your space treat their effective caster-attribute as +1 for the duration of that effect. Works on allies and on you; does not work on qliphothic-register effects.

  • Light of Harmony. When two or more creatures within 6 squares of you are in active, explicit agreement (stated aloud), they each gain 1 temporary Integrity. This refreshes when a new agreement is reached between different creatures.

Ophanic Traits

  • Wheel-and-Eye. You can see invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as dimly lit shapes. You cannot be flanked.

  • Concentric Sight. You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks that involve noticing movement, pattern, or change over time. You roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on Mind (Perception) checks to notice things that have been perfectly still since before you started looking — you see motion, not furniture.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Intrigue marks and +10 Violence marks at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Battlefield / Procession / High-Traffic hexes, your Domain's observation and counter-intel operations gain +2 on the success check.

  • Turning Witness. Once per turn, you may observe one exchange of goods, intelligence, or personnel between two rival factions within your field of influence. You learn that it happened and between whom, though not necessarily what was exchanged.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Sefirot Attunement Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free (declare before roll)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. Invoke your chosen sephirah for +1 rank bonus on a check clearly in its domain.

Unity Field. Your conviction radiates outward like a stabilizing field.

  • While you are conscious, you emit a 2 squares aura. Allies in the aura (including you) reroll the lowest die on defense checks against being charmed or Shaken.
  • Once per turn when a creature starts its turn in your aura, you can grant it temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value (no action required).

(The Active Effect marks you as projecting the Unity Field aura; GMs and scripts can key off this flag.)

Your voice becomes a tactical relay.

Allies who can hear you may treat your space as the origin point for any ability they use that requires verbal projection, including:

  • Shouts, commands, speeches
  • Inspiring or intimidating effects
  • Sound-based class features

This allows allies to affect targets they could not normally reach, as long as you are within range of them, even if they are not.

Crisis Mediator. You specialize in talking people down from the brink.

  • When you resolve a significant scene that could have become a combat encounter (or escalated to violence) using primarily Diplomacy, Performance (Presence), Insight (Soul), or other nonviolent means, you may apply one of the following effects, as appropriate to the fiction:
  • • Darkness –1 in the affected hex or faction (to a campaign-appropriate minimum).
  • • +10 Soft Power marks to your Domain at the end of the turn.

You can apply this feature once per scene, and a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

Sephirotic Scion. Your blood remembers the higher spheres. Light hangs around you a little too long, prayers sometimes answer themselves, and the world’s moral architecture feels less like an abstraction and more like the weather report.

Sephirotic Scion Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).

  • Size. You are Medium.

  • Speed. Your walking speed is 6 squares

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Sephirotic Scion does not grant any attribute bonuses.

Your Sephirotic heritage grants you additional features through advancements (Item Grants) added during character creation: sephirotic physiology, attunement to higher patterns, holy conduction, the Light of Harmony, and strategic hooks that tilt factions toward soft power, diplomacy, and alignment work.

Out-of-combat: the per-use Counter-Discord reaction (cancel a deceit-based reroll within 12 squares) and the hex-scale All-Seeing Eye remain the strategic flourishes.

Tier 2 — Gridbreakers

“Everything broken still remembers how it worked.”

Gridbreakers treat dead cities like sleeping machines. They know how to pry power from broken substations, wake lights in abandoned towers, and make a ruin choose sides. Where others see debris, they see leverage.

You’ve stopped scavenging ruins and started running them.

  • Tactical: —
  • Strategic: Your Domain can restore or jury-rig infrastructure in Ruins/Urban Wreckage more efficiently. Facilities and urban systems are cheaper to reactivate, repair, or stabilize.

Silver Tongue Protocol. You have rehearsed, iterated, and field-tested the art of getting people to actually talk.

  • Whenever you make a Diplomacy (Presence) or Stealth (Intrigue) check, you can treat a rolled result of 8 or lower on the 2d10 as a 9 instead. You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your Presence value (minimum once).
  • In Parley, you can spend one use of this feature to reroll the lowest die on a single Influence roll.

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Diplomacy (Presence) and Stealth (Intrigue) checks as a quality-of-life bonus.)

Read the Room. You have an instinctive feel for the emotional geometry of conversations.

  • When you make an Insight (Soul) or Perception (Mind) check to gauge mood, detect Stealth, or sense the underlying stakes of a scene, you can add a d4 to the roll.
  • You can use this feature after you roll but before the GM tells you whether you succeed. Uses per Soma Break equal to your Soul value (minimum once).

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Insight (Soul) and Perception (Mind) checks.)

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: You gain a skill rank in Faith and Intimidation.

  • Strategic: Your Domain's passive OP bias now follows the base Archetype file.

“You glow a little. Sometimes metaphorically. Sometimes not.”

  • You can cast calm emotions 1/Soma Break (Presence is your manifestation aptitude).
  • Allies within 2 squares reroll the lowest die on checks against being frightened.
  • You automatically sense the Sephirothic/Qliphothic tilt of any hex you enter.

description.value:
Peacekeeper's Poise. Your presence steadies people at the exact moment everything could go sideways.

  • When initiative is rolled, you can choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Presence value (minimum one) within 6 squares of you. Each gains temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value + your tier.
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

"You're not the hero. You're the reason the heroes don't trip over each other."

The Harmony Marshal runs on Surge like everyone — but yours arrives sideways: when an ally within 6 squares lands a surging roll (an exploding 10), the brilliance resonates into you and you bank a Surge too (+1, max +2/round). The party's best moments are your fuel; you spend them feeding the party back. Your tier powers are Surge spends, and the rerolls auto-fire now — no GM bookkeeping:

The Mandate (spent via Surge)

  • Rallying Words (1) — an ally banks a reroll-lowest on their next roll.
  • Ease Attrition (2) — heal an ally and clear one condition.
  • Rally to Me (2) — an ally banks a reroll and frees a reaction.
  • Unity Flourish (3) — every ally within 6 squares banks a reroll.
  • Conductor's Crescendo (5) — the whole line banks a reroll and each clears a condition.

The strategic layer endures out of combat — Attrition Easer, Loyalty Steward, and Unity Conductor still move Soft Power, attrition, and hex loyalty on the campaign turn. In a fight, though, you are a reroll engine: the dice obey you because you asked nicely, at exactly the right moment.

description.value:
Calm the Mob

Crowds don’t think. They feel. So you give them something else to feel.

Rules

You gain a skill rank in Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) (your choice). If you already have it, its rank rises by one instead.

When you spend at least 1 minute addressing a group of non-hostile or uncertain creatures, you may make a Presence (Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence)) check (DC set by the GM). On a success, you reduce immediate hostility: the crowd hesitates, disperses, or agrees to hear terms. On a failure, you still buy time, but a complication occurs (a challenger steps forward, guards arrive, a rumor spreads).

⚙ +1 to Diplomacy or Intimidation — whichever you rank higher.

  • On the strategic layer, once per turn when you personally participate in a Parley, Battle, Heist, or other opposed Domain operation, you can grant your side a +1 bonus to one opposed roll representing speeches, appeals, or visible leadership.

Judgment - Necessary force. +1 Violence, +1 Logistics OPs

Geburah draws the line. It rewards discipline, enforcement, and decisive action against fortified problems, but always risks becoming cruelty if severity outruns wisdom.

Medic of the Wastes

Out here, healing is logistics.

Rules

You gain a skill rank in Faith (Soul). If you already have it, its rank rises by one instead.

When you use a medkit to stabilize a creature, it also regains Integrity equal to your rank bonus.

Additionally, during a Scene Break, you may allow up to two creatures to regain additional Integrity equal to your rank bonus. A creature can benefit from this principle only once per Scene Break.

⚙ +1 Faith. 🃏 Card — shows the Integrity numbers.

  • The imposed penalty or forced reroll is canceled.

Harmony Initiate. You are a designated Harmony asset for your Domain.

  • You gain a skill rank in Diplomacy (Presence) and Insight (Soul) (handled by the Harmony Marshal class traits).
  • When you are the active Harmony Marshal for a Domain, that Domain’s Soft Power generation increases by 10% (rounding in your favor). The GM can apply this as a +10% modifier or as a small bonus whenever it would meaningfully matter for the current campaign scale.
  • This feature is Bad Eden-only and interacts with your Domain sheet’s Soft Power track and marks pipeline.

You elevate a single voice until it carries a whole room.

As a bonus action, choose one ally within 12 squares who can hear you. Until the start of your next turn:

  • The ally rerolls the lowest die on their next Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) check.
  • If that check shifts a crowd, faction representative, or social tempo, your Domain gains +10 Soft Power marks for the next turn (once per scene).

This represents you turning someone into the right voice at the right time.
